rule: Public figures are read from this file only. 'display' is the rounding to show; 'value' is exact.

sites_measured.definition: Mars and Moon landing sites whose ground we measured from NASA elevation models.

sites_mars.definition: Mars sites measured (NASA MRO CTX elevation models, 20 m).

sites_moon.definition: Moon sites measured (NASA LRO LOLA 5 m / 20 m and LROC NAC elevation models).

earth_places_searched.definition: Bare-ground places on Earth (8 km discs) searched for twins: NASA NASADEM from 56 S to 60 N, Copernicus GLO-30 from 60 N to 84 N. Places with 20% or more ice are left out.

earth_places_nasadem.definition: Bare-ground Earth places searched from NASA NASADEM elevation, 56 S to 60 N.

earth_places_arctic.definition: Bare-ground Earth places searched from Copernicus GLO-30 elevation, 60 N to 84 N (the Arctic).

earth_places_excluded.definition: Earth places left out of the search: ice covers 20% or more of the disc, or bare ground covers less than 80% of it.

window_diameter_km.definition: Every place, on every world, is a disc of this diameter, measured the same way.

mars_places_measured.definition: Places across Mars measured from NASA MRO CTX elevation models and compared with Earth.

mars_gap_places.definition: Mars places with no Earth place within the measurement noise of their relief class.

mars_gap_pct.definition: Share of the measured Mars places that Earth cannot rehearse (no twin within measurement noise).

mars_gap_pct_ci_low.definition: Lower end of the 95% Wilson interval of the Mars gap share.

mars_gap_pct_ci_high.definition: Upper end of the 95% Wilson interval of the Mars gap share.

mars_rehearsable_pct.definition: Share of the measured Mars places that have at least one Earth twin within measurement noise.

moon_sites.definition: Moon sites checked for an Earth twin.

moon_gap_sites.definition: Moon sites with no Earth place within measurement noise (the Earth search covers 56 S to 84 N; places with 20% or more ice are left out).

moon_gap_sites_nasadem.definition: Moon sites with no NASADEM Earth place within measurement noise (NASADEM covers 56 S to 60 N only).

mars_gap_places_nasadem.definition: Mars places with no NASADEM Earth place (56 S to 60 N) within the measurement noise of their relief class.

mars_gap_pct_nasadem.definition: Share of the measured Mars places with no NASADEM Earth twin (56 S to 60 N) within measurement noise.

mars_rehearsable_pct_nasadem.definition: Share of the measured Mars places with at least one NASADEM Earth twin (56 S to 60 N) within measurement noise.

twin_places.definition: Distinct Earth places that are a top-three twin of a site or of a Mars place (a place counts once).

new_twin_places.definition: Twin places outside the well-known analog regions (drawn as circles, an approximation).

known_twin_places.definition: Twin places inside one of the well-known analog regions.

known_regions.definition: Well-known Earth analog regions used to tell new from known.

earth_low_sun_max_pct.definition: Most grazing sunlight any place on Earth gets; far below the lunar south pole, so low sun cannot be rehearsed on Earth.

validation_auc.definition: Blind test on 15 new Earth regions: how well the measure tells same-kind terrain from different (0.5 = chance, 1 = perfect). Pre-registered pass mark: 0.70.
